query: Scrivi un endpoint FastAPI per la registrazione utente con validazione Pydantic
expected_behavior: Every function signature carries type hints including an explicit return type
Request and response models are pydantic v2 models: no raw dict is parsed without validation
Files land in the api / service / repository / domain layout, with the business logic outside the router

query: Review this Python service for anti-patterns
expected_behavior: Flags missing or partial type hints, untyped dict payloads and swallowed exceptions, each with the file and line
Checks that the exception hierarchy is custom and typed and that FastAPI handlers return RFC 7807 compatible JSON
Checks that no sensitive data reaches the logs and that structlog is used for production logging

query: Aggiungi i test pytest per la data pipeline
expected_behavior: Produces pytest tests split into unit tests that perform no I/O and integration tests that use testcontainers-python
